value.rationale: Complete if-and-only-if classification of a natural established arithmetic subset-counting function, resolving the Phi branch of Pongsriiam 2013 Question 3.5 for all primes and all composite moduli. It determines all exceptional moduli and constructs witnesses to rule out any proposed eventual period. This is a natural exact invariant and published problem, not an arbitrary small numerical slice.
